checks.finding: requirements.md Field Definitions and REQ-002/REQ-004 give concrete, pattern-bound definitions (id/name/context/must_not_own/distinguished_from/evidence/etc. with explicit regex and minLength/minItems rules), and REQ-004(c) explicitly orders type-check before pattern/minLength/minItems checks. No term, actor, state, input or output surface was found where two implementers would reasonably diverge; boundary examples (`APIOrder`, `order-taking-2`) are given to pin down pattern edges.

requirements.md REQ-005 states verbatim: '(b) Book/Bookshelf の正例（Book.must_not_own に display position、Placement concept が並び責務を持つ）' — i.e. the minimum Book/Bookshelf fixture must have Book's must_not_own populated with 'display position'. But acceptance-tests.md AC-004 (mapped 1:1 to REQ-005(b), row: 'AC-004 | REQ-005(b) | TEST-004 | positive fixture (optional 全欠落) | ... Book/Bookshelf 正例 fixture（Book が並びに関する責務を持たず、Placement concept が並び責務を持つ）が通過。本 fixture は concept の optional フィールドを 1 つも持たない状態とし、must_not_own・stakeholder_perspectives・distinguished_from の 3 キーをいずれも欠落させる。') now explicitly requires must_not_own to be ABSENT for every concept in that same fixture, and the string 'display position' does not appear anywhere in acceptance-tests.md (verified by direct search). REQ-005(b)'s literal fixture-content mandate and its own mapped AC's literal fixture-content mandate directly conflict, and no other AC provides the missing fixture — an implementer cannot satisfy both texts with one fixture, and the specific must_not_own='display position' example demonstrating the P1 concept-boundary capability described in Problems/US-003 is now unrealized by any test. This is a fresh regression introduced by this round's rewrite of AC-004 (which repurposed it to be the 'optional-fields-all-absent' canary to satisfy last round's Major finding), and it belongs to spec review because it is a direct textual conflict between requirements.md and acceptance-tests.md, not an implementation ambiguity.

Negative-path coverage matrix cross-checked cell-by-cell against the AC table's own per-AC fixture counts (AC-014=7, AC-017=2, AC-018=3, AC-019=3, AC-020=4, AC-021=7, AC-022=2, AC-023=8, AC-024=29, single-fixture ACs=8; sum 65+8=73 matches the document's own stated tally). Material negative/empty/boundary/failure modes from requirements.md (empty concepts[] array AC-016, malformed/oversized JSON AC-017, self-referencing distinguished_from AC-008, v1-schema-rejected AC-012, duplicate id/name AC-006/AC-011, dangling references AC-007/AC-008/AC-009, self-contradicting responsibilities/must_not_own AC-010, every declared pattern/minLength/minItems/type constraint AC-018/AC-019/AC-023/AC-024) are each covered by a dedicated fixture. This check is independent of the REQ-005(b) positive-fixture gap flagged under CONTRADICTION, which concerns a missing positive-capability demonstration rather than a missing negative path.

investigation.md's OQ-003 (essence required) and OQ-004 (v2-only validator, explicit error on v1 input) are resolved directly in requirements.md: REQ-002/Field Definitions marks essence Yes/required, and REQ-004(b) plus Edge Cases mandate the explicit 'schema is domain-contract/v1...' error. OQ-001 (v1 file disposition) and OQ-002 (CI/run-all registration) remain open but do not block Phase 0 — Non-goals and REQ-007 already fix Phase 0 behavior (v1 untouched, no migration tooling) independent of their eventual resolution. The Assumptions section explicitly records the hook-activation deviation (CAPABILITY_RUNTIME_UNAVAILABLE) with an owner decision to proceed, which is a resolved-not-hidden assumption.

Non-goals explicitly excludes 'meta.status の Approved 書込に対する機械的強制機構（hook-guard 保護パスへの登録、承認 sidecar 等）の新設', and Roles and Permissions states this feature adds no mechanical enforcement — 'Phase 0 において承認境界は人間のレビュー運用のみが担保し、v2 スキーマは meta.status を単なる列挙値フィールドとして定義するに留める'. The contract JSON itself is agent-editable (INV-008, no hook-guard protection) and human-copy flow is explicitly not required. No approval, governance, or irreversible-change boundary is in scope for this feature's own artifacts, so the skip condition applies.

Aside from the REQ-005(b)/AC-004 conflict already captured under CONTRADICTION, requirements.md's Field Definitions table, exhaustive REQ-004 validator check list ((a)-(i)), and Roles/Workflows sections give an implementation-policy reviewer sufficient concrete behavior (patterns, required/optional splits, error-reporting format, fail-closed semantics, single-context membership) without needing to invent product behavior. Forward references to design.md (DD-1, DD-4) cite design rationale for already-fixed requirements decisions, not deferred product decisions.
